_comment: F244 candidate models, pinned. Revisions were read from the Hugging Face API on 2026-09-17 and
the SHA-256 of model.safetensors is filled in by models.py after the first verified download, so
a later fetch that does not match refuses rather than silently benchmarking different weights.
The baseline (qwen3-8b) is the app's installed Summarizer runtime and is never downloaded here.
Gemma 4's license is Google's Gemma Terms of Use, not Apache-2.0 as the 2026-09-14 survey said;
corrected here from the model card on download day.
